title: COP Accounting Base Types
description: Base types for COP/Accounting events and artifacts. Provides exact quantity representation, account identifiers, and common governance fields.

ExactQuantity.description: Exact quantity representation using decimal coefficient and scale. No binary floating-point arithmetic for authoritative quantities.

coefficient.description: Decimal coefficient as string to preserve precision. Can be positive or negative. Example: '123456789' for 1.23456789 when scale=8, or '-500' for -5.00 when scale=2.

scale.description: Number of decimal places. Example: 8 for 1.23456789, 2 for -5.00.

unit.description: Unit of measure for the quantity. Required for authoritative accounting.

ResourceAssessment.description: Native-resource observation for an invocation. A missing reliable quantity is represented explicitly, never as an invented fiat valuation.

AccountIdentifier.description: Canonical account identifier. MUST accept HTTPS URLs including identity URLs like https://jhn.baronsmariani.org/. Format: one of (1) canonical HTTPS URL, (2) URN, (3) local account reference in form 'local:{type}:{id}'.

AccountingDomain.description: Accounting domain scope. Balancing is enforced within (resourceType, unit, accountingDomain). Different domains never balance implicitly.

ResourceType.description: Type of resource being accounted. Examples: 'kudos', 'fiat', 'cpu-time', 'storage', 'reputation'.

DisclosureClass.description: Disclosure class controlling visibility in projections. Public projections must not require private purchase content.

GovernanceContext.description: Governance fields for accountability and mandate compliance.

actor_subject_id.description: The subject who physically acts. The agent or person executing the action.

principal_subject_id.description: The subject on whose behalf the action is taken. Distinct from actor when delegation occurs.

mandate_id.description: Reference to the mandate artifact authorizing this action. Required when actor != principal.

capacity_basis.description: Legal or organizational basis for the capacity to act (e.g., role, contract, court order).

acting_as.description: Role or office under which the actor is exercising capacity.

Posting.description: A single posting within a transaction. Debits and credits must balance exactly.

posting_type.description: Posting type. In accounting, debit increases asset/expense accounts, credit increases liability/equity/revenue accounts.

BudgetReference.description: Reference to a budget artifact or event.

version.description: Optional version identifier for optimistic concurrency.

EvidenceReference.description: Reference to evidence artifacts supporting the accounting event.

role.description: Role of this evidence in supporting the event.

timestamp.description: When this evidence was created or observed.
